description: This file defines a Fragment named ProductListFragment used in an Android app to display a list of products. It manages UI components such as RecyclerView for listing products, a search input for filtering, and a greeting message. It also includes inner classes for Adapter and ViewHolder to bind Product data to the UI. The fragment observes a ViewModel for product data and handles navigation to a product detail activity.

classes.name: ProductAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView.Adapter subclass responsible for managing and binding Product data to item views. It provides a submit method to update its dataset.

classes.name: ProductViewHolder
classes.description: A RecyclerView.ViewHolder subclass that binds individual Product data to UI components within the item view, handling click events.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout from XML, creating the View hierarchy.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up RecyclerView, binds greeting text, attaches search listener, observes product data, and triggers loading of products.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Updates the adapter's dataset with a new list of Products and refreshes the display.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ProductViewHolder for the RecyclerView.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a Product item to a ProductViewHolder.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the current number of Product items in the adapter.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a Product object to the ViewHolder's views, populating product details.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ProductListFragment.
